work_packages.title: Operating kit and harness compatibility checks
work_packages.objective: Install the proposed skills and agent guides only after authorisation, then record discovery, explicit reference, natural triggering, nested guidance, permissions and fresh-session evidence in OpenCode v2, the only harness. G1 covers authorised install/discovery and G2 the seven-check matrix; G3 was retired 2026-11-17.
exit_criteria: 5 skill designs and 3 feature guides exist
G1 and G2 remain unpassed until installation is approved and the matrix is executed

work_packages.title: Repository hygiene and dependency baseline
work_packages.objective: Remove committed node_modules, add .dockerignore and lockfile installs, pin supported Node/Next/Express/mysql2 versions, fix the vulnerable advisory set, make the dashboard build hermetic, and repair readme/compose.
work_packages.stop_condition: Stop if a dependency pin cannot be installed from the registry; record the exact failing package.

work_packages.title: Data, configuration and migration foundation
work_packages.objective: Add a validated config module, MYSQL_PORT support in all pools, numbered migrations that create both tables idempotently, ordered/clamped log queries, bounded log writes and retention. Migration compatibility is tracked by the separate gate G11, not by the harness gate G2 (DEC-028).
exit_criteria: SEPARATE PERSISTED ACCEPTANCE CRITERION - migration compatibility (gate G11, not harness G2): fresh MySQL 8.4 initialises from numbered migrations with no manual SQL; a re-run is a no-op; a pre-migration schema is adopted idempotently; paging inputs 0, -1, abc, 101 and 1000000000 are validated; the retention job prunes seeded old rows. Synthetic or focused tests never satisfy this criterion or G2; gate closure requires cited evidence under DEC-028.
work_packages.stop_condition: Stop if existing production data must be preserved without a qualified owned dump; the legacy prod-pre-1.1.0-20261117T011520.sql dump is not qualified (9p/DrvFS, 0777, no 0600) and must not be used as a fixture or rollback.

work_packages.title: API security and contracts
work_packages.objective: Add sessions, roles, CSRF, validation, rate limits, correlation ids, CORS allowlist, hash redaction, restart job endpoint and the .env.example.
exit_criteria: no hash appears in responses or logs
work_packages.stop_condition: Stop if the owner requires an external identity provider; record the requirement.

work_packages.title: Bot command core refactor
work_packages.objective: Introduce a single command context and handler contract, bounded dedupe cache, awaited sends, one ready handler, dynamic help and the flip/nchain/joke fixes.
work_packages.stop_condition: Stop if a fix would change a preserved reply's wording without a recorded decision.

work_packages.title: Command-specific fixes
work_packages.objective: Fix weather parsing/timeouts/errors, bound the free-games response, cache the profanity list with safe fallback, and add regression fixtures.

work_packages.stop_condition: Stop if the upstream API shape changed; record the new fixture.

work_packages.title: Live status and dashboard data
work_packages.objective: Add heartbeat/uptime, make the status route dynamic, show real guild and heartbeat data, and add per-guild health.
exit_criteria: status reflects a new login without rebuild
stale session shows offline within threshold

work_packages.title: Dashboard security and operator UI
work_packages.objective: Server-validated sessions, login/logout/CSRF, user management, log explorer with export, analytics data, responsive accessible theme and self-hosted assets.
work_packages.stop_condition: Stop if visual review is impossible; record the unverified visual gate.

work_packages.title: Verification suite and documentation
work_packages.objective: Local unit, HTTP contract, integration and build checks; `npm run verify`; per-area guides and CHANGELOG.
exit_criteria: verify passes from a clean clone
